# Next Generation Science Standards

> NGSS is a comprehensive K-12 science education framework emphasizing three-dimensional learning through disciplinary core ideas, science practices, and crosscutting concepts.

Developed by Achieve, the National Research Council, and partner organizations, NGSS provides standards, implementation guidance, and evaluation tools for science curriculum and instruction. The site offers resources for understanding, implementing, and assessing NGSS-aligned instructional materials.

## Key Topics

- Next Generation Science Standards (NGSS)
- Three-Dimensional Learning
- Disciplinary Core Ideas
- Science and Engineering Practices
- Crosscutting Concepts
- EQuIP Rubric for Science
- K-12 Science Education
- Instructional Materials Evaluation

- Science Assessment
- A Framework for K-12 Science Education

- Engineering Design

## Core Standards and Framework

- [The Standards](https://www.nextgenscience.org/standards): Complete NGSS standards with Disciplinary Core Ideas and performance expectations
- [Home Page](https://www.nextgenscience.org): Homepage introducing NGSS framework with three-dimensional learning approach
- [Understanding the Standards](https://www.nextgenscience.org/understanding-standards/understanding-standards): Guide to understanding NGSS structure and three-dimensional learning framework
- [Understanding NGSS Design](https://www.nextgenscience.org/understanding-ngss-design/understanding-ngss-design): Comprehensive guide to NGSS design principles and evidence-based assessment
- [NGSS Appendices](https://www.nextgenscience.org/resources/ngss-appendices): NGSS appendices covering practices, core ideas, and crosscutting concepts
- [Developing the Standards](https://www.nextgenscience.org/developing-standards/developing-standards): History and process of NGSS development by Achieve, NRC, and partner organizations

## Implementation and Assessment Tools

- [EQuIP Rubric for Science](https://www.nextgenscience.org/resources/equip-rubric-science): EQuIP rubric for evaluating NGSS-aligned instructional materials and lessons
- [Instruction and Assessment](https://www.nextgenscience.org/instruction-and-assessment/instruction-and-assessment): Guide to NGSS-aligned instruction and assessment using EQuIP rubrics
- [NGSS Lesson Screener](https://www.nextgenscience.org/screener): Interactive tool for screening lessons against EQuIP Rubric for Science
- [Science Assessment Task Screening Tools](https://www.nextgenscience.org/task-screening-tools/science-assessment-task-screening-tools): Assessment task screening tools for evaluating three-dimensional learning alignment
- [Evaluating NGSS Design](https://www.nextgenscience.org/evaluating-ngss-design/evaluating-ngss-design): Framework for evaluating instructional materials against NGSS design criteria

## Recognition and Quality Assurance

- [NGSS Design Badge](https://www.nextgenscience.org/badge): Digital badge recognizing NGSS-aligned instructional materials meeting EQuIP standards
- [NextGenScience Peer Review Panel](https://www.nextgenscience.org/peer-review-panel/nextgenscience-peer-review-panel): Information about peer review panel evaluating NGSS-aligned curriculum

## Reference and Support

- [Glossary](https://www.nextgenscience.org/glossary): Terminology reference for NGSS and K-12 science education framework
- [FAQs](https://www.nextgenscience.org/faqs/faqs): Frequently asked questions about NGSS development and implementation
- [News](https://www.nextgenscience.org/News): News archive and NGSS Now Newsletter updates for science standards
